business_problem: Yangshipin needed a secure, data-driven media architecture that could unify user, content, and production data while supporting large-scale video distribution, AI-assisted production, and 5G-era media operations.
solution_summary: China Media Group's Yangshipin platform uses Tencent Cloud as the data and capability backbone for a national 5G new-media service. Tencent built a hybrid-cloud base with public, dedicated, and private cloud resources, and the dedicated environment uses two availability zones for disaster recovery. On top of that foundation, Yangshipin runs a capability middle platform composed of a video middle platform, AI middle platform, and big-data platform. The system ingests client behavior, user data, media assets, production-system data, and internet trend data, then applies unified governance, warehousing, analytics, recommendation, storage, transcoding, content review, intelligent clipping, and smart cover generation. Client apps, creator accounts, content operations, and security controls all consume these shared services. The result is a data-driven media architecture where content production, distribution, and operations all draw from one governed platform instead of isolated systems.

solution_components.role: Provides the public, dedicated, and private cloud base for resilient new-media operations.

solution_components.name: Video Middle Platform

solution_components.name: AI Middle Platform
solution_components.role: Adds intelligent services such as content review, smart clipping, and recommendation support.

solution_components.name: Big Data Platform
solution_components.role: Processes and analyzes large volumes of audience, content, and production data.

solution_components.name: Data Middle Platform
solution_components.role: Defines the unified data-governance model and shared data services for the business.

data_flow: Client behavior, user, media-asset, production, and internet trend data flow into the big-data and data-middle-platform layers, where governance, storage, recommendation, analytics, and AI services feed content operations, creator workflows, apps, and reporting across the Yangshipin ecosystem.
business_outcome: Yangshipin gained a governed media data platform that improves content quality, operational coordination, AI-assisted production, and security for a national-scale video service.
